subject: Invite: Architect High-Touch Webinar — RSVP seed & reminder plan
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Thomsen <alex.t@cloudbridge.com>
Date: 2028-07-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Invite: Architect High-Touch Webinar — RSVP seed & reminder plan

Team — looping you in on CloudBridge (Alex) to finalize the inbound invite for the architect-focused webinar on Aug 16. Key asks below: 

1) Seed list: attached "audience_seed_list.csv" is our proposed priority seed (architects at CloudBridge + top active customers who used private deployment features). Please flag any rows to remove.
2) Tracking: attached "tracking_link_matrix.xlsx" contains per-segment UTM parameters + HubSpot link mapping. We should use utm_source=cb-partner, utm_campaign=architect-aug16, and utm_content for segment (vip/priority/engaged).
3) Cadence: propose initial invite, one reminder at 48 hours, final reminder at 6 hours pre-event, and a VIP-only 24-hour reminder with a personalized calendar invite link.
4) High-touch asks for CloudBridge: include a dedicated RSVP slot for their engineers (limit 30) and a pre-event 30-min office hours slot.

Attachments: audience_seed_list.csv (CSV stub), tracking_link_matrix.xlsx (XLSX stub)

Draft next steps: Ben — can you review cadence + HubSpot mapping by EOD today? Mina — can you draft two email subject line variants and a VIP snippet? Karthik — please confirm routing for US-west demo sessions (we want the recording stored in us-west region).

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Partnerships & Field Marketing
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Thomsen <alex.t@cloudbridge.com>
Date: 2028-07-22T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invite: Architect High-Touch Webinar — RSVP seed & reminder plan

Jonas — thanks for the plan, looks good. A couple of quick adjustments: 

- Add a VIP segment column in the seed list (I marked ~18 rows that should be VIP).
- For reminders: I prefer 72h / 24h / 2h for general audience and VIP gets 48h / 6h + a personal calendar link. The 72h will help capture architects who book farther out.
- HubSpot: I'll update the tracking matrix to include a hidden field for "architect_track=true" to simplify follow-up workflows.

I updated the tracking_link_matrix.xlsx (attached) with the hidden field note. Also adding a HubSpot view: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/view/architect-invite to gate follow-up.

If CloudBridge agrees to the VIP slot, we'll create a dedicated RSVP form for that 30-head slot (manual approval).

-Ben
Senior Field Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Invite: Architect High-Touch Webinar — RSVP seed & reminder plan

Adding copy options and tracking examples below — feel free to paste directly into a HubSpot email block. I kept things short (architects appreciate brevity).

Primary invite copy (short):
Join us Aug 16 for a focused session on scaling LLM inference with predictable latency and cost. We’ll demo Redwood’s latest private deployment optimizations and a CloudBridge customer case study. Reserve your seat — architects only.
CTA: Reserve my seat (link with utm_content=general)

VIP snippet (for the VIP segment email):
As a CloudBridge partner you have priority access to a 30-person hands-on slot and a 30-minute pre-event office hour with our solutions engineers. Claim your VIP seat now (link with utm_content=vip).

Reminder subject line variants:
- "Reminder: Architect webinar Aug 16 — limited VIP seats"
- "Final: Office hours & VIP seats close in 6 hours"

Tracking examples (use these as sample final links so ops can QA):
- General: https://redwoodinference.com/rsvp?utm_source=cb-partner&utm_campaign=architect-aug16&utm_content=general&utm_medium=email
- VIP: https://redwoodinference.com/rsvp?utm_source=cb-partner&utm_campaign=architect-aug16&utm_content=vip&utm_medium=email&architect_track=true

I'll draft two subject line A/B variations and upload both email HTML snippets to the Drive folder (link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cSeedListDocs).

-Mina
Content & Lifecycle Manager
Redwood Inference

Thanks Jonas & team — CloudBridge is happy to proceed with the VIP slot and promoted seed. A few notes from our side: 

- Our engineering leadership prefers events in US-west-friendly times (we recommend 11:00 PT / 2:00 ET).
- Please include a calendar invite for VIPs when their seat is approved.
- We'll send an internal note to our eng slack to surface the invite; please provide a one-line summary and the final RSVP link.

I confirmed the 30-seat VIP list on our side; you'll see the matching emails in your seed list (I flagged them with a comment). Please go ahead with the 72h/24h/2h general cadence + 48h/6h VIP extras as Ben suggested.

Alex
